```{r Data preparation}

library(gllvm)
library(dplyr)

microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```

```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}
# Function to fit generating ('true') GLLVM model and obtain fitted conditional mean values
model_and_pred = function(Y, X, l.v.){
  # Fit Poisson GLLVM using Laplace Approximation
  # Y = n x J responses
  # X = n x p environmental covariates
  # l.v. = no. of latent variables
  true_model = gllvm(Y, X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA", gradient.check = TRUE)
  # Obtain fitted conditional response means, including contribution from predicted latent variables
  pred_counts = predict(true_model, type = 'response', lv.pred=TRUE)
  #Return original data, fitted generating model, fitted conditional means
  return(list(Y = Y, X = X, true_model = true_model, pred_counts = pred_counts))
}

# No. of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Generating model with 1 latent variable
# Fit original microbial dataset with 1 l.v.

#model_pred = model_and_pred(Y = microbial[, 1:200], X = as.matrix(scale(Xenv[, 1:2])), l.v. = 1) 
#save(model_pred, file = "model_pred.RDATA")
load("model_pred.RDATA")

# Generate B simulated datasets conditionally on l.v. from fitted generating model
# Simulations stored as stacked 56 x 200 datasets

#sim_counts_all = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = B, conditional = TRUE)
#save(sim_counts_all, file = "sim_counts_all.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Create folder where fitted gllvms are stored
dir.create("gllvm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
# Storage for simulation results
time_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #fitting time for each of the simulations
KL_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #KL divergence between generating conditional means and fitted conditional means
loglik_new_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #conditional Poisson log-likelihood
loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1 = rep(NA, B) #gllvm's reported log-likelihood

# Environmental covariated used in each fitted model
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
# No. of l.v.
l.v. = 1

# Refit gllvm with 1 l.v. to each simulated dataset
for (k in 1:B){
  time_i = system.time({
    gllvm_sim_1 = gllvm(y = sim_counts_all[(56*(k-1) + 1):(56*k), ], X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
  
  # Save fitted GLLVM from each simulation 
  save(gllvm_sim_1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", paste0("gllvm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  # Obtain fitted conditional means from refitted model
  pred_counts = predict(gllvm_sim_1, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
  # Fitted Poisson mean
  mu = pred_counts
  # Conditional means from original generating model
  true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts
  
  # Store summary quantities
  time_all_gllvm1[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
  KL_all_gllvm1[k] = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - log(pred_counts)) - (true_mu - pred_counts)) 
  loglik_new_all_gllvm1[k] = sum(dpois(sim_counts_all[(56*(k-1) + 1):(56*k), ], lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
  loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1[k] = gllvm_sim_1$logL
}

# Mean, standard deviation of fitting time
time_int_gllvm1 = c(mean(time_all_gllvm1), sqrt(var(time_all_gllvm1)))
# Mean, standard deviation of KL divergence
KL_int_gllvm1 = c(mean(KL_all_gllvm1), sqrt(var(KL_all_gllvm1)))

save(time_all_gllvm1, KL_all_gllvm1, loglik_new_all_gllvm1, loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1, time_int_gllvm1, KL_int_gllvm1, file = file.path("gllvm_models", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}
# Number of simulated datasets
B = 100

# Load fitted generating model, B simulated datasets as conacatenated 56 x 200 blocks
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Alternating GLM fitting function
alt_glm = function(sim_counts, X, u, true_mu, N){
  
  # Initial log-lik used for convergence check
  loglik = -Inf
  new_X = cbind(1, X) #56 x 3
  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(sim_counts), ncol = 1 + ncol(X) + ncol(u)) # Preset matrix of coefficients including betas and lambdas, nrow = no. of columns in the responses, ncol = beta0, beta1, beta2, lambda
  
  # Measure total elapsed fitting time
  time_i = system.time({
    
    # Alternate between species update and site updates until convergence or until N
    for (iter in 1:N){
      X_u = cbind(new_X, u)
      
      # Column update - estimate beta, lambda for each species, conditional on u
#      suppressWarnings(
      for (j in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
        if (iter == 1) {
          warm_start_j = NULL
        }
        else {
          warm_start_j = as.numeric(beta_lambda[j, ])
        }
        
        glm1 = try(
          glm.fit(y = sim_counts[, j], x = X_u, intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log'), control = glm.control(maxit = 70), start = warm_start_j), silent = TRUE) 
          # Fallback for when warm-start fit fails, retry using default starts
          if (inherits(glm1, "try-error") ||
              any(!is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
            glm1 = glm.fit(y = sim_counts[, j], x = X_u, intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log'), start = NULL, control = glm.control(maxit = 80))
          }
        
        beta_lambda[j, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) #1 x 4
        }
#        )
      # Extract fixed-effect coefficients
      beta = beta_lambda[, 1:(ncol(X)+1), drop = FALSE] #200 x 3
      # Extract latent-variable loadings
      lambda = beta_lambda[, (ncol(X) + 2):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u)), drop = FALSE] #200 x 1
#      lambda = pmax(lambda, -2000)
      offset = new_X%*%t(beta)
      
      # Row update - estimate latent score u for each site, conditional on current beta, lambda 
      # Preset matrix for updated u
      new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(sim_counts), ncol = ncol(u)) #56 x 1

#      suppressWarnings(
        
      for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
        
        glm1 = try(
          glm.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = offset[i, ], control = glm.control(maxit = 80), start = as.numeric(u[i, ])), silent = TRUE)  #invalid type without as.numeric
          # Fallback for when warm-started fit fails
          if (inherits(glm1, "try-error") ||
              any(!is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
              glm1 = glm.fit(y = sim_counts[i, ], x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = offset[i, ], control = glm.control(maxit = 70), start = NULL)
          }
    
        new_u[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) 
        }
#      )
      # Update u
      u = new_u #56 x 1
      # Fitted means, log-lik
      eta = offset + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
#      eta = pmax(eta, -2000) #clamping to limit the exp(eta)
      mu = exp(eta)
      pred_counts_i = mu

      loglik_new = sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
      # Convergence check
      if (is.finite(loglik) && is.finite(loglik_new)) {
        rel_change = abs(loglik_new - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new))
    
        cat(
        "iter =", iter,
        "loglik =", loglik,
        "beta = ", range(beta),
        "lambda = ", range(lambda),
        "u = ", range(u),
        "eta = ", range(eta),
        "loglik_new =", loglik_new,
        "rel_change =", rel_change,
        "\n")
      if (rel_change < 1e-6) break
      }
      loglik = loglik_new
      if (is.finite(loglik) == FALSE) {stop("Loglikelihood is infinite")}
    }
    
    }) 
  
  return(list(time = as.numeric(time_i[3]), KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_counts_i)), ite_converge = iter, loglik_new = loglik_new, beta = beta, lambda = lambda, u = u, pred_counts = pred_counts_i))
}

# Fit alt_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
time_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glm1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])

for (k in 1:B){ #start here for function - input Y, X
  glm_sim_1 = alt_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[(56*(k-1) + 1):(56*k), ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts, N = 100)
  
  save(glm_sim_1, file = file.path("glm_models", paste0("glm_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))
  
  # Store summary quantities
  ite_converge_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$KL
  loglik_new_all_glm1[k] = glm_sim_1$loglik_new
}

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations
time_int_glm1 = c(mean(time_all_glm1), sqrt(var(time_all_glm1)))
KL_int_glm1 = c(mean(KL_all_glm1), sqrt(var(KL_all_glm1)))
#load("glm_sim_1.RDATA")
#way of storing each model -- use debugger after lik

save(time_all_glm1, KL_all_glm1, ite_converge_all_glm1, loglik_new_all_glm1, time_int_glm1, KL_int_glm1, file = file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))
```

```{r alternating glms, 1 l.v. updating through constraints -- Chen Error in if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y) missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed k = 13}
# Project y onto L2 ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  y = as.numeric(y)
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}

B = 100

# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Constrained JMLE fit
lv_chen = function(sim_counts, X, u, K, true_mu, N){

  n = nrow(sim_counts) # 56
  J = ncol(sim_counts) # 200
  c = 5 * sqrt(K) # constraint radius

  # Store beta, lambda
  beta_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1 + ncol(X))
  lambda_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u))

  # initialize beta, lambda from Poisson GLMs
  time_i = system.time({
    for (j in 1:J) {
      fit_j = glm.fit(
        y = sim_counts[, j],
        x = cbind(1, X, u), 
        family = poisson(link = "log")
      )
      coef_j = as.matrix(t(fit_j$coefficients))
      beta_all[j, ] = coef_j[1: (1 + ncol(X))]    
      lambda_all[j, ] = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u))]
    }
    
    # Storage for projected updates
    beta_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1 + ncol(X)) 
    lambda_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u)) 
    u_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = ncol(u)) #56 x 1
    
    # Initialise lik
    loglik = -Inf
    for (iter in 1:N) {
    # Row update
      suppressWarnings(
      for (i in 1:n) {
        
        # Fit u with offset 
          glm1 = try(glm.fit(
          y = sim_counts[i, ],
          x = as.matrix(lambda_all),   # J x 1
          intercept = FALSE,
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          offset = cbind(1, X)[i, ] %*% t(beta_all), # 1 x 200
          start = u[i, ],
          control = glm.control(maxit = 50)
        ), silent = TRUE)
          # Stop when fit fails
          if (inherits(glm1, "try-error")) {
            stop(paste("Row glm.fit failed:", 
                       "iter = ", iter,
                       "i = ", i,
                       "\n",
                       glm1)
                 )
          }

        new_u = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
        # Constrain u
        u_proj[i, ] = proc(new_u, sqrt(c^2 - 1))
      }
      )
      u = u_proj

      # Column update, update beta, lambda
      X_u = cbind(1, X, u)
      
      suppressWarnings(
      for (j in 1:J) {
        # Warm starts
        start_vec = c(beta_all[j, ], lambda_all[j, ])
        
          glm1 = try(glm.fit(
          y = sim_counts[, j],
          x = X_u,
          family = poisson(link = "log"),
          start = start_vec,
          control = glm.control(maxit = 50)), silent = TRUE)
          # Stop if fit fails
          if (inherits(glm1, "try-error")) {
            stop(paste("Column glm.fit failed:", 
                       "iter = ", iter,
                       "j = ", j,
                       "\n",
                       glm1)
                 )
            }
      
        #if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
        coef_j = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
        #} else {
          #coef_j = start_vec * 0.8
        #}
        # Extract beta, lambda
        beta_j = coef_j[1:(1 + ncol(X))]
        lambda_j = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u))]
        
        # Constrain beta, lambda
        comb_j = c(beta_j, lambda_j) #4 x 1
        comb_proj = proc(comb_j, c)
        
        beta_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[1:(ncol(X) + 1)]
        lambda_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u))]
        }
      )
      
      # Update parameters with constrained versions
      beta_all = beta_proj
      lambda_all = lambda_proj
      
      # Fitted means, log-lik
      eta = cbind(1, X) %*% t(beta_all) + u %*% t(lambda_all) #56 x 200
#      eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -10), 10)
      mu = exp(eta)
      pred_counts_i = mu
      
      loglik_new = sum(dpois(sim_counts, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
      
      cat(
        "iter =", iter,
        "loglik =", loglik,
        "beta = ", range(beta_all),
        "lambda = ", range(lambda_all),
        "u = ", range(u),
        "eta = ", range(eta),
        "loglik_new =", loglik_new,
        "\n")
      
      # Convergence check        
      if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new)) < 1e-6) break
      loglik = loglik_new
      if (is.finite(loglik) == FALSE) {stop("Loglikelihood is infinite")}
    }
    })
  return(list(time = as.numeric(time_i[3]), KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_counts_i)), ite_converge = iter, loglik_new = loglik_new, beta = beta_all, lambda = lambda_all, u = u, pred_counts = pred_counts_i))
}

# Fit lv_chen to B simulated datasets
```

```{r glmnet - penalty on lambda and u using 1 l.v.}
B = 100

# Load generating model, simulated datasets
load("model_pred.RDATA")
load("sim_counts_all.RDATA")

# Alternating penalised Poisson GLM fit
pen_glm = function(sim_counts, X, u, true_mu, N){
  
  loglik = -Inf
  new_X = cbind(1, X) #56 x 3

  # Preset matrix for beta, lambda for each species
  beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(sim_counts), ncol = 1 + ncol(X) + ncol(u)) 
  # Warm starts
  warm_start = vector("list", ncol(sim_counts))
  warm_start_u = vector("list", nrow(sim_counts))

  time_i = system.time({
    for (iter in 1:N){
      
      X_u = cbind(X, u)
      # Column update, beta, lambda, beta unpenalised, lambda penalised
#        suppressWarnings(
      for (j in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
        glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = sim_counts[, j], x = X_u, weights = rep(1, nrow(sim_counts)), intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log'), warm = warm_start[[j]], alpha = 0, lambda = 1, penalty.factor = c(rep(0, ncol(X)), rep(1, ncol(u))))
        # Store coefficients
        beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) #1 x ncol(1+X_u)  as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
        warm_start[[j]] = list(a0 = as.numeric(glmnet1$a0), beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
      }
      
      beta = beta_lambda[, 1:(ncol(X)+1), drop = FALSE] #200 x 3
      lambda = beta_lambda[, (ncol(X) + 2):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u)), drop = FALSE] #200 x 1

      offset = new_X%*%t(beta)
      # Preset matrix for u
      new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(sim_counts), ncol = ncol(u)) #56 x 1
  
      # Row update, u
      for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
        glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, weights = rep(1, ncol(sim_counts)), intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = offset[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 1, warm = warm_start_u[[i]]) #invalid type without as.numeric
        
        # Store updated u
        new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
        warm_start_u[[i]] = list(a0 = as.numeric(glmnet1$a0), beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
      }
      # Update u
      u = new_u #56 x 1
      
      # Fitted means, log-lik
      eta = offset + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
      mu = exp(eta)
      pred_counts_i = mu
      
      loglik_new = sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
           
      cat(
        "iter =", iter,
        "loglik =", loglik,
        "beta = ", range(beta),
        "lambda = ", range(lambda),
        "u = ", range(u),
        "eta = ", range(eta),
        "loglik_new =", loglik_new,
        "\n")
      
      # Convergence check        
      if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new)) < 1e-6) break
      loglik = loglik_new
      if (is.finite(loglik) == FALSE) {stop("Loglikelihood is infinite")}
       }
    }) 
  
  return(list(time = as.numeric(time_i[3]), KL = sum(true_mu*(log(true_mu) - eta) - (true_mu - pred_counts_i)), ite_converge = iter, loglik_new = loglik_new, beta = beta, lambda = lambda,  u = u, pred_counts = pred_counts_i))
}

# Fit pen_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glmnet_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
time_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
KL_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
ite_converge_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
loglik_new_all_glmnet1 = rep(NA, B)
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])

for (k in 1:B){
  glmnet_sim_1 = pen_glm(sim_counts = sim_counts_all[(56*(k-1) + 1):(56*k), ], X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), true_mu = model_pred$pred_counts, N = 200)

  save(glmnet_sim_1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", paste0("glmnet_sim_1_", k, ".RDATA")))

  ite_converge_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$ite_converge
  time_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$time
  KL_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$KL
  loglik_new_all_glmnet1[k] = glmnet_sim_1$loglik_new
}

# Mean, standard deviation across simulations
time_int_glmnet1 = c(mean(time_all_glmnet1), sqrt(var(time_all_glmnet1)))
KL_int_glmnet1 = c(mean(KL_all_glmnet1), sqrt(var(KL_all_glmnet1)))

save(time_all_glmnet1, KL_all_glmnet1, ite_converge_all_glmnet1, loglik_new_all_glmnet1, time_int_glmnet1, KL_int_glmnet1, file = file.path("glmnet_models", "glmnet1_summary.RDATA"))
```
